verdict.rationale: Supabase documents and runtime-probes confirm each piece of this workflow — CLI can init/start projects and run keylessly (supabase-docs-5/32, supabase-probe-rt-1), the Management API supports programmatic project/org management (supabase-docs-28), migrations apply schema via CLI (supabase-docs-25), and the hosted MCP server (live per supabase-probe-rt-2) lets an agent query the database and manage migrations without the dashboard (supabase-docs-1, supabase-docs-2, supabase-docs-4). However, no single first-party walkthrough stitches create→connection-string→schema→query into one dashboard-free flow, and community reports flag real friction in the migration story ('local development & database migration story is Supabase's biggest weakness... I hate having to do migrations live in prod' and dashboard-editing being discouraged but common) plus MCP prompt-injection risk acknowledged by Supabase engineers. Missing for 10: a documented single end-to-end example combining all four steps, and resolution of community-reported migration/dashboard friction.
